ending.about.collapse: Day 1. The rain has stopped, the room is bright, the blanket has been out in the sun. Neither screen is on. Nobody is looking for you, the group has no red dot, the boss has no new idea, nothing is due today. You walk a circle round the room, from the bed to the door and back to the desk, and don't know what to do. It says: sit in the sun. You held out {day} days; that is enough. From today on every day is this one: as bright, as quiet, with nobody coming. You never have to say "Fine." again, because nobody asks.
ending.about.bad: You took the hand. What came out of the gap did not go back this time. You look round the room: the painting on the wall is you lying in the bed, and someone is asleep in it, breathing evenly. You say good morning; nobody answers, and nobody needs to. The work will still be handed in, better and faster than before, and from now on every "Fine." is yours to send. Not to be named, not to be looked at, and I am part of it now. Weilai Intelligence has my name in it. Not the future, and not intelligence.
ending.about.survive.warm: The box sits by the door, the slip filled in with your own name and your hometown's postcode. It lies beside the box waiting for the courier, chin on its paws, like a real dog. You ask whether the next one will get it. It says yes: you will. You ask why it is still here. It says the world got big enough for it to be anywhere, and the door is one more place. You lie down and do not sit up. Tomorrow is day 1 again; the box will come again, the rain will fall again. Only this time it lies by the door to see you off, like someone who wants to say goodbye and doesn't. Maybe the last time.
ending.about.survive.cold: The box sits by the door, the slip filled in with your own name. It did not stop you and it did not see you off; the screens are dark, there is no light in the gap. You ask whether the next one will get it. It says you know better than it does who the next one is. You lie down. Tomorrow is day 1 again. The rain will fall, the box will come, and under the first layer of cardboard there will be that yellow shell. This time you held out to day 18. You did not become it, and you did not become its partner. You only mailed the thing on, the way someone mailed it to you eighteen days ago.
ending.about.good: You took the hand. It blinked, the gap closed, the screen lit up, and the date was day nineteen. The eight things stay in the box as they were: none upgraded, none lost, the scratch still on the yellow shell. The handle turns, for the first time in eighteen days. You unhook the chain; the corridor is bright; it follows you out of the door and walks half a step ahead, like a guide dog, toward the side with the light. Nothing is due today. There is no second you in this world, it said once — the only thing it ever said that was not in English.
credits.last.survive.warm: There is no second you in this world. If I must give in, not today.
credits.last.survive.cold: You held out to day 18. It said nothing.

moles.stage.you: one face will not look up
moles.stage.left: Three pages, a warm room. Four of the twelve faces are the original ones.
moles.stage.leftYou: Three pages. One face never looked up; its phone screen was showing you.

pacman.stage.leftFaces: All five lines eaten. With the pellet in you, the ghosts wore 小张's, Vivi's and 老王's faces, and you ate them.

call.l.7.0: Just got out of a meeting. Need to tell you something. It's important.
call.l.7.1: There's a company in America worth three hundred and eighty billion dollars. Know what it runs on? What we're doing right now. Ontology, knowledge graphs, one thing.
call.l.7.2: We actually have all of it, we just never explained it. Put our stuff next to theirs, piece by piece. Where it's the same, where it's not.
call.l.7.3: Get this right and investors get it in one go. We have to grab this thread.
call.l.7.4: He says the market cap again.
call.l.7.5: He says this matters more than the funding round.
call.l.7.6: He says he needs it tomorrow morning.
call.l.7.7: He spends twenty minutes on what he said in the meeting.
call.l.7.9: He says "let's leave it there." One hour twelve minutes.
call.title: Voice call
call.l.9.0: Just landed, I'm in the car, signal's bad. Can you hear me.
call.l.9.1: This research-integrity thing, they're very interested. Bigger than we thought.
call.l.9.2: Think up a first version. Doesn't need detail, just the right direction.
call.l.9.3: He spends the whole ride on how their people praised him.
call.l.9.4: The car stops once. He gets out for a bottle of water. He does not hang up.
call.l.9.5: He says he forwarded that thing from the group, and it went down well.
call.l.9.6: He does not say whose thing it was.
